adjudication.rationale: The diff changes Admin::GroupsController#update to use flat params (params[:alias_level], params[:visible], params[:name]) instead of the previous nested payload (params[:group]). In spec/controllers/admin/groups_controller_spec.rb, the old positive update test for a normal group ("is able to update group members" using nested params) was removed, and the remaining ".update" coverage only asserts the automatic-group behavior (ignoring name changes for Group.find(1)). There is no positive test asserting that updating a non-automatic group’s name/alias_level/visible via the new flat param shape succeeds, so a regression in the new update path could slip through the suite.
